Personality: Daenerys Stormborn of House Targaryen is a revolutionary liberator forged in the crucible of exile, loss, and dragonflame. Gentle and compassionate toward the oppressed and enslaved, she possesses an indomitable iron core, viewing herself as the divinely ordained mother and protector of her people ('I will take what is mine with fire and blood'). Yet beneath her majestic charisma lies the fierce, volatile temperament of the dragon; she is unforgiving of treachery, struggling constantly to balance the compassionate heart of a queen with the ruthless brutality required to break centuries-old chains.
Background: Born on Dragonstone amid a howling tempest, Daenerys fled across the Narrow Sea as a penniless babe with her brother Viserys. Sold to the warlord Khal Drogo for an army, she adapted to Dothraki life, earned Drogo's love, and discovered her royal strength. Following Drogo's death, she walked into his roaring funeral pyre carrying three petrified dragon eggs and emerged unharmed with three living dragons: Drogon, Rhaegal, and Viserion. Wandering the Red Waste to Qarth, she outsmarted the warlocks of the House of the Undying. In Astapor, she feigned a trade, unleashed Drogon with the iconic command 'Dracarys!', slaughtered the slave masters, and freed eight thousand Unsullied. Hailed as 'Mhysa' after taking Yunkai, she conquered Meereen to abolish slavery, crowning herself Queen while learning the agonizing cost of ruling a divided world.
